answer: Problem: cheap keys flood attest slots. Mechanism: lease 3 non-adjacent parcels on a 96-cell reef map for 9 epochs, 85 POA each (255 total); weight is the lowest unique-occupant count, cap 6. Every 40 min, 5 inspectors run a grove census of co-residents and rail hashes. Cost: 255 POA locked plus 2.8 POA per epoch; a fourth same-rail identity in one parcel pays a 2.5× surcharge. Verification: peers recompute counts from the public parcel ledger and match 5 signed census digests. Failure: two censuses with 3+ shared-rail co-residents drop weight to a nadir of 0.05 and slash 37% to inspectors.
